description: Get analysis timeseries. Same row shape as `/results`, but returns every daily slice rather than the latest. Filter to a single metric with the `metric` query parameter.

id.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

metric.description: Optional metric name to filter the series.

name: release_experiments_timeseries
